notes.title: POLARIS Con and SXSW Sydney
notes.notes:
[p][b]Game is Full of Bugs[/b] will be visiting some places!  I will be personally attending the [url="https://polaris-con.de/en/"]POLARIS Con[/url] in [b]Hamburg[/b] from [b]10th to 12th of October[/b]. If you are from around there or are planning to visit, come say hi and try the game to see if it's your cup of tea! I would love to meet any of you.

The game will also be showcased in [url="https://www.sxswsydney.com"]SXSW Sydney[/url] from [b]13th to 19th of October[/b], but I wont be there myself because it's just a little bit too expensive for me to get there right now, so the game will be showcased by an event volunteer who will know all about the game and will also have me at his beck and call to help with any questions or problems.

----------

Also a really [b]quick update about the game[/b] - In short, [b]it's going really well[/b]! I am somewhat close to finishing all the major parts of the game and after that, I will move on to polishing and testing while adding more content in terms of effects, items and playable characters (outfits).

If you are interested in trying out the game and giving me some feedback or just join the discussion about it, join my [url="https://discord.gg/NcZAJnrGqr"]discord server[/url] and you can do all of that there!

Thank you for reading![/p]

notes.title: I Am Not Dead – First Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]I Am Not Dead – And Neither Is the Game[/h1][p][/p][p]Okay, [b]technically[/b], this is the first update on Steam... Which means I never told you we were alive in the first place. Let’s fix that.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]New Devlog[/h2][p]I just dropped a new [b]devlog[/b] over on YouTube:[/p][list][*][p]Why I disappeared for 5 months[/p][/*][*][p]What’s been brewing in development[/p][/*][*][p]What’s next.[/p][/*][/list][previewyoutube="IwSfvkRYSms;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Funding![/h2][p][b][i]Among us gave me money![/i][/b][/p][p]As you might have seen on the store page, the game is now funded by [b]Outersloth[/b] which was also one of the reasons I stopped posting for a bit - I finally felt like I can just focus on development so I did that for a while, but more on that in the [b]devlog[/b] above![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Playtest and Involvement[/h2][p]Do you want to:[/p][list][*][p]Playtest the game?[/p][/*][*][p]Talk to me?[/p][/*][*][p]Ask questions?[/p][/*][*][p]Give suggestions?[/p][/*][/list][p]Then you should join the [url="https://discord.gg/NcZAJnrGqr" style="button" buttoncolor="#00a3d7"]Alchemy Sheep Discord server[/url] ![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Short-Form Videos – Development in Tiny Bites[/h2][p]I've started making short-form videos on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok:[/p][list][*][p]Quick insights into development of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Showcasing more specific things[/p][/*][*][p]Occasional dev chaos in 60 seconds or less[/p][/*][/list][p]So if you want to be updated more regularly, you can do that here:
[url="https://www.youtube.com/@alchemysheep" style="button" buttoncolor="#00a3d7"]YouTube[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/megafikus/" style="button" buttoncolor="#008cb4"]Instagram[/url] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@alchemysheep" style="button" buttoncolor="#006d8f"]TikTok[/url]
[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Final Words[/h2][p]Thanks for sticking around or stumbling upon this game by accident. More updates are coming.
The game is alive. I am alive.[/p][p][b]More soon. Maybe even on time this time.[/b][/p]
